question: Is there a native path across time among paths of four rings and three shared contacts in two restricted families: all three contacts persist, and the last contact binds the end rings at every lag from the light-cone lag on?

public_inputs.carriers: artifacts/AFFINE-WIRE-20261108-001B/AFFINE-WIRE-20261108-001B-E001_affine_search/run/positives.json (sha256 6e5f0e3804b3390214b0c75495c3ba5beb909d32044b0015149ce809fbb15c3e): AFFINE-WIRE-20261108-001B's 430 carrying chains (both contacts persistent, composing, d >= 2).
public_inputs.run: run.py in this folder, 16 worker processes.
public_inputs.family one: Rule 150 on all four rings; end rings of 3 to 5 cells; middle rings of 4 to 7 cells with their two contacts at least two cells apart; every law at each of the three contacts (10 each): 900,000 paths.
public_inputs.family two: Each carrying chain extended by a fourth ring after its last one: the old last ring becomes a middle ring with a new contact at least two cells from the old one; the new end ring's rule in 90, 150, 60, 102, 170 and 240, its size 3 to 5, and every law at the new contact: 96,840 paths.
public_inputs.exactness: Every verdict is exact by ticket A's reduction.

forbidden_inputs: Changing either family after seeing results
primary_observable: Per family: paths with all three contacts persistent; among them the native paths (ends bound at the last contact from the light cone on), those with the ends bound at both end contacts, and those whose last contact binds every ring.
cheapest_meaningful_control: The smallest native paths, if any, with at most 15 first-row cells, must give the same verdicts on their full state spaces.
first_executable_signal: The control, or a count of zero.
decision_or_followup_rule: H1, frozen: some native path exists in at least one family. If H1 holds, verify the smallest and report the native path across time. If not, record the absence for these restricted families only, and register a broader sweep in docs/LONG_RUNNING.md.
stop_rule: Stop when every path of both families has its verdicts.
nonclaims: Exploratory and non-promotable: the two restricted families only.
feasibility_disclosure: Before freezing: ticket A's library and check were written and run (800 random small four-ring paths, none native). run.py --pilot timed 500 random paths of each family (4.3 s and 0.5 s) and printed no verdicts.
